fontes.promptIntegral: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production game sprite with true transparent alpha, a single enormous nightmare cockroach for a painterly 2D storybook forest. Subject: clearly recognizable COCKROACH, broad flattened reddish dark brown segmented wing cases, large shield behind the head, six long spiny articulated legs, two very long thin antennae, small mouth palps. Frontal three-quarter low view looking toward the viewer, body receding backward; all six legs and antenna tips fit completely inside canvas with generous transparent margins. Two distinct small luminous pale amber eyes on the low head, separated and clearly locatable, no beams painted into the sprite because dynamic light cones are drawn by the game. Face is insect anatomy, not a human face, not cute. Massive imposing silhouette as if it were the moving scenery behind a tiny girl. Hand painted gouache and fine digital storybook detail, textured chitin, deep indigo shadows and muted copper edge lighting, matching a dark blue enchanted forest. Ominous tense nightmare suitable for a storybook adventure, no blood, no gore. Composition: single centered full body cockroach, wide landscape canvas, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no rocks, no trees, no text, no border, no checkerboard baked in. Actual transparent background.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent sprite atlas for a dark painterly 2D storybook forest stealth game. Exactly THREE separate large natural boulders, arranged horizontally in three equal cells with wide transparent gutters and all silhouettes entirely contained in their cell. The boulders are massive enough to hide a small child: a rounded tall granite rock on the left, a broad angular dark slate rock in the middle, a leaning irregular weathered boulder on the right. Each has a flat convincing ground contact at the same baseline, painted fissures, chips, lichen and just a little moss near base. Front/three quarter view, not top down, human eye height relative to a tiny girl. Hand painted gouache texture and detailed storybook illustration. Deep desaturated blue/gray stone, muted cool purple in cracks, gentle blue moon rim on upper edges. No emitting light, no glowing symbols. Opaque solid objects without holes. No white outlines, no platform lines, no cast shadow, no ground island, no sky, no scenery, no people, no insect. No text, numbers, labels, grid or watermark. Real transparent alpha background, no checker pattern painted into pixels. Wide horizontal canvas.

No background, no props, no blanket, no cast shadows, no text/letters/watermark. Actual transparent alpha.
